prompt: Exactly as in the image: at a neighbourhood kirana shop's steel counter on a busy lane, beside an open white delivery van, a young delivery man in a grey t-shirt hands one sealed brown carton across the counter to the shopkeeper, a man in a cream kurta. The delivery man turns his face toward the shopkeeper and says clearly, in an Indian English accent: "Your twenty-four packets, sir. The invoice is already on your phone." The shopkeeper takes the carton with both hands, looks at him and replies with a calm, pleased expression, speaking clearly, his lips shaping every word, in an Indian English accent: "Very good! These will be gone by Sunday." Only after his last word does he break into a smile. Each man's mouth moves only while he is speaking, in time with his words. The camera is locked off. Audio: their two voices clear, the gentle bustle of the lane behind them, no music.
